configuration.sample_statistics: p50/p95 use nearest-rank; singleton measurements report p50=p95; context continuations are three samples
configuration.memory_scope: peak_process_rss_bytes includes worker startup validation; phases execute in separate processes
configuration.event_loop_scope: monitorEventLoopDelay during phase plus one setImmediate; sample_count zero means no timer tick was observed
configuration.wal_scope: SQLite -wal file size before and after each phase; not checkpointed bytes or disk I/O
configuration.context_continuation_cost: re-fetches and orders the pinned snapshot; three measured pages, not constant-time
